title: 02. Homepage Sections & Clinical Specialties (Edit on Home Page)

fields.label: Hero Headline
fields.name: hero_headline
fields.default_value: When surgical oncology demands indisputable clarity.

fields.label: Hero Subheadline (Dr. Jem Bio)
fields.name: hero_subheadline
fields.default_value: Dr Jem Kalathil is a Surgical Oncologist with over thirty years of experience and is Lead Senior Consultant, Surgical Oncology, at the Aster International Institute of Oncology, Aster Medcity, Kochi. His practice is focused on three areas: oncoplastic breast cancer surgery and reconstruction, sentinel node biopsy and radio-guided localisation of non-palpable lesions; cytoreductive surgery with HIPEC for peritoneal surface malignancies; and robotic and complex surgery for gastrointestinal and gynaecological cancers, and extremity and retroperitoneal sarcomas.

fields.label: Editorial Statement Line 1
fields.name: editorial_statement_1
fields.default_value: A second opinion is not disloyalty.

fields.label: Editorial Statement Line 2
fields.name: editorial_statement_2
fields.default_value: It is an essential oncological safeguard.

fields.label: Editorial Lead Paragraph
fields.name: editorial_lead_prose
fields.default_value: The days following a biopsy are often overwhelmed by shock, urgent advice, and irreversible choices. Patients are told that surgery must take place tomorrow.

fields.label: Editorial Body Paragraph
fields.name: editorial_body_prose
fields.default_value: Yet in thirty years of specialized surgical oncology, we know that taking 3 to 5 days to confirm histological receptors, re-examine scan boundaries, and explore organ preservation does not compromise curative outcomes. It protects both life and enduring dignity.

fields.label: Surgeon Profile Detailed Bio
fields.name: surgeon_profile_bio
fields.default_value: Trained in the United Kingdom, Italy, Singapore and India, including a UICC Fellowship in Milan under Professor Umberto Veronesi, he was formerly Additional Professor of Surgical Oncology at the Regional Cancer Centre, Thiruvananthapuram. He heads the Aster Clinical Research Centre and is Lead Principal Investigator on clinical trials.

title: 03. Patient Voices & Testimonials (Edit on Home Page)

fields.label: Review Text / Experience (1)
fields.name: test_1_quote
fields.default_value: Dr. Jem Kalathil provided the exact clarity our family needed during an overwhelming breast cancer diagnosis. His calm demeanor, organ-preservation focus, and surgical precision gave my wife full confidence. Five years cancer-free today.

fields.label: Review Text / Experience (2)
fields.name: test_2_quote
fields.default_value: We traveled from Muscat, Oman for Dr. Jem’s second opinion on peritoneal surface cancer after local doctors in the Gulf considered surgery impossible. The HIPEC cytoreduction gave us new hope. His team’s care is world-class.

fields.label: Review Text / Experience (3)
fields.name: test_3_quote
fields.default_value: As a doctor myself, I appreciate Dr. Jem’s absolute clinical honesty and mastery. He explains surgical margins, risks, and alternatives without exaggeration. The gold standard in surgical oncology across South India.

fields.label: Review Text / Experience (4)
fields.name: test_4_quote
fields.default_value: Minimally invasive robotic procedure with rapid recovery. Back on my feet in three days. Thank you Dr. Jem Kalathil and surgical team for your compassion and guidance.

title: 06. Upload Records Page (Edit on Page Slug: upload-records)

fields.label: Page Lead Description
fields.name: ur_page_lead
fields.default_value: Submit your pathology reports, imaging scans, and clinical summaries directly for review by Dr. Jem Kalathil and his clinical second-opinion team.

fields.label: DPDP & NMC Statutory Consent Text
fields.name: ur_consent_text
fields.default_value: By submitting these medical records, you authorize Dr. Jem Kalathil and his clinical review team to evaluate your diagnostic reports solely for specialist surgical second opinion and clinical triage. All uploaded records are encrypted in transit and at rest in compliance with applicable Indian medical data protection standards (including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and NMC ethics guidelines). Submission of records for a second opinion does not establish a formal doctor-patient relationship; an in-person physical consultation or formal teleconsultation is required before any treatment plan is finalized or initiated.
